title: The Care Between
purpose: CTIN 290 Storyboards & Animatics workshop: passage of time, minimal dialogue
generation_disclosure: Original AI-generated fictional teaching imagery made with Higgsfield GPT Image 2.5. No real people or student work. Selected, revised and visually checked; the images are storyboard stills, not live-action footage.
processing: Source masters were cropped with ImageMagick into individual frames and reflowed into a 4-column by 2-row contact sheet. No content was painted or synthesized in Python. Framing comparison outputs were fit inside 1920×1080 without cropping content.

checked: Single watering can in each frame
Consistent cracked pot, workbench and window motif
Visible dry-soil diagnosis and watering cause
No immediate recovery after first watering
No faces, labels, logos or dialogue
qa.limitations: These are illustrative continuity boards, not scientifically timed plant-growth diagrams. Fine crack geometry and window perspective vary slightly across the drawn coverage. The final wide echoes the first rather than being a pixel-identical locked camera.
